# Ravolution AB

> Swedish venture studio and angel investor building deep tech platforms in language learning, voice security, AI trade infrastructure, and K1–K9 education. Founded by inventor Ivan Daza (27 patents, 343 claims).

Ravolution AB operates a Build-for-Equity model, invests directly as an angel, and runs a portfolio of patented platforms — iApply, CommunicaringSchool, AIMagnifica (enterprise AI governance & compliance layer, available for sale), Rosetta Livingstone, SINGUISTIC (music-native language learning, live in 26 languages), xPortMatch, VoiceProtector, NewsToast, BizMeet, CarbonX, Partysta, It's a Fitt, AlarmSole (connected footwear safety platform, patent pending), PikpCash (direct sales gamification platform, concept documented 2017).

## Pages

- [Apply for Tech Investment](/en/apply): Application page for early-stage startups seeking build-for-equity investment (engineering, product, and angel capital in exchange for equity). Response within 10 working days.
- [Home](/en): Overview of the venture studio, portfolio, and three engagement pillars.
- [About Ivan Daza](/en/about): Founder biography, expertise, track record, and vision.
- [Services](/en/services): Platform development, product & design, AI systems, and IP/patent strategy.
- [Build for Equity](/en/build-for-equity): Partnership model — we build defensible platforms in exchange for equity.
- [Angel Investor](/en/angel-investor): Direct early-stage capital with patent strategy and technical co-founder support.
- [Invest](/en/invest): Investor landing page for qualified leads.
- [Portfolio](/en/portfolio): Operated and licensed platforms across 6+ industries.
- [SINGUISTIC™](https://singuistic.com): Music-native language learning platform — synced dual-language lyrics, tap-to-save vocabulary, spaced repetition and CEFR-anchored student reports. Live in 26 languages.
- [Beredskapad.se](/en/beredskapad): Swedish digital crisis preparedness platform concept — education, assessments, checklists and guidance. Available for acquisition.
- [Hundelser.se](/en/hundelser): Swedish social platform for dog owners — dog profiles, community content, friendships, activities, challenges and marketplace opportunities. Available for acquisition.
- [Partysta.com](/en/partysta): Party planning and memory-sharing platform — invitations, guest coordination, budgets, shared responsibilities and event memories. Available for acquisition.
- [BizMeet™](/en/bizmeet): White-label community operating system for organisations running 2,000–20,000 members. Replaces Meetup, Eventbrite, Mailchimp, Slack and Stripe with one branded platform.
- [AlarmSole™](/en/alarmsole): Connected footwear safety platform — a discreet smart sole activated through the foot to send SOS, live location and emergency workflows. Patent pending PRV 2630522-7. Open to investment, OEM, licensing and strategic partnerships.
- [PikpCash®](/en/pikpcash): Direct sales gamification platform — turns every address into a point of sale and selling into a level-based game. Zero barriers to start earning. Concept documented 2017. Investor access available.
- [Patent Strategy for Startups](/en/patent-strategy-for-startups): Guide to strategic IP for founders.
- [Technical Cofounder Alternative](/en/technical-cofounder-alternative): How we replace a missing technical co-founder.
- [Brief](/en/brief): Intake form to submit a platform concept.
- [Contact](/en/contact): Direct email and inquiry channels.
- [Blog & Podcast](/en/blog): Long-form thinking on IP, venture building, and deep tech.
